npcs.lore: Recycled training units fitted with a calibration tap. Their swing is soft; their persistence is not.
npcs.name: Calibration Bot Mk-I

npcs.lore: Heavier sibling of the Mk-I. The Bloom claims the upgrade is for 'realistic baseline pressure.' The chip logs the bruises either way.
npcs.name: Calibration Bot Mk-II

npcs.lore: The Overseer ends every baseline. Outlasted, it signs the chip's first real entry. Outclassed, it grinds the chip back down for re-calibration.
npcs.name: Calibration Overseer

npcs.lore: Emerald growth binds the slabs. The seams glow faintly before it tears one open.
npcs.name: Emerald Crystal Golem

npcs.lore: General White holds the Icy Plateau in the high north. Commands the ground he's standing on with rifle support from the ridges. Three escalations, no surrender. Drop him and the chain of command breaks.
npcs.name: General White

npcs.lore: Slabs of rock still wet from the ground. Hitting one with anything blunt is a waste of a swing.
npcs.name: Rock Golem

npcs.lore: More crystal than rock, and it shows: lighter, faster, and far more willing to open the ground under you.
npcs.name: Rose Crystal Golem

npcs.lore: The blue seams are not decoration; they are what it throws.
npcs.name: Sapphire Crystal Golem

races.description: A wise and resilient race from Planet Namek. Known for their regenerative abilities, spiritual connection, and mastery of Ki-based techniques.
races.name: Namekian

races.description: A fierce Saiyan warrior with unmatched agility and fighting spirit. Capable of achieving the legendary Super Saiyan transformation.
races.name: Saiyan

spells.description: Palm out, elbow locked. Force is compressed into a single blue-white sphere and released in one punch of pressure.
spells.name: Big Bang Attack

spells.description: A shout that dares everything nearby to come at you. Enemies in range drop whoever they were chasing and turn on you, and stay angry at you for a while after.
spells.name: Challenging Roar

spells.description: Draw in ambient ki to replenish your reserves. Leaves you stationary and vulnerable while channeling.
spells.name: Charge

spells.description: Gather ki in your palm and let it build. Release early for a quick pellet, or hold to full for a blast that detonates on impact.
spells.name: Charged Ki Blast

spells.description: Every fight you have been in leaves something behind. A flat, permanent edge in all four combat stats, no conditions attached.
spells.name: Combat Instinct

spells.description: Years of basic training pay off. Small permanent boost to attack, defense, and max HP, plus steady out-of-combat HP and Ki regen.
spells.name: Conditioning

spells.description: The old Namekian discipline: mend rather than break. Everything good you put on yourself or on an ally lands harder and holds far longer, and your own body knits quietly on its own.
spells.name: Dragon Clan Rites

spells.description: Pull every scrap of ki inward until it has nowhere left to go, then let go. The wave flattens everything standing near you and leaves you wide open in the crater.
spells.name: Explosive Wave

spells.description: Split the ground and let it run. A seam tears away from your feet and erupts along its length, each burst throwing up the one ahead of it until the line spends itself.
spells.name: Fissure Wave

spells.description: A single compressed wall of air shoved forward off the palm. It does little more than bruise, but whatever it lands on leaves the ground.
spells.name: Force Push

spells.description: More arms than you have, and all of them swinging. The punches leave wide and wrong-footed, then turn in and land together. Any one of them is nothing much. They do not arrive one at a time.
spells.name: Four Arm Avalanche

spells.description: Push your own ki across the gap and into someone who needs it more. Lands on a chosen ally, and keeps working on them after it lands. It has nothing to give an enemy.
spells.name: Helping Hand

spells.description: Calm the mind and harden the body. Raises ki and physical defense for a short time.
spells.name: Inner Focus

spells.description: Warp instantly behind a targeted enemy, even up or down a cliff, arriving on their level.
spells.name: Instant Transmission

spells.description: Take four hits inside five seconds and you stop giving ground. Damage lands softer and knockback barely moves you, for as long as they keep coming.
spells.name: Iron Will

spells.description: Multiply your ki past what the body can hold. Strength and speed spike behind a crimson aura, but the strain burns Ki and slowly bleeds stamina — hold it too long and the technique drops on its own.
spells.name: Kaioken

spells.description: Cupped hands, a long breath, and every scrap of ki you can gather goes down one line. Hits far harder than a plain beam and empties you at twice the rate holding it.
spells.name: Kamehameha

spells.description: You learn from every fight. Small permanent boost to XP gained from all sources.
spells.name: Keen Mind

spells.description: A sustained lance of raw ki. No homing, just heavier impact than scattered bolts.
spells.name: Ki Beam

spells.description: A quick burst of focused ki hurled in a straight line. Cheap, fast, and reliable.
spells.name: Ki Bolt

spells.description: Hold at a quarter health for three full seconds and something in you digs in. Heavy damage reduction and real regeneration, for as long as you stay there.
spells.name: Last Stand

spells.description: Drive both fists into the ground and let the shock do the rest. Dust erupts outward in a flat ring, throwing everything nearby off its feet, and the churned earth often catches a leg on the way past.
spells.name: Mighty Impact

spells.description: Ki gathers around you and takes the shape of the beast. The heads launch skyward and come down in waves, each one hitting like something with weight behind it rather than light.
spells.name: Primal Barrage

spells.description: Throw up a shell of ki. For the first instant it is wound tight enough to throw projectiles straight back off it, and it holds as a softer guard for a moment after. Read the shot and it costs you nothing. Read it late and it still takes half.
spells.name: Reflection Barrier

spells.description: Three down inside ten seconds and you stop slowing between them. Keep the streak alive and it keeps paying.
spells.name: Relentless

spells.description: Drop any active transformation cleanly without burning what's left in your reserves.
spells.name: Revert

spells.description: Water drawn up out of nothing, hanging around you in droplets before it breaks over the ground in rings. Everyone standing with you is mended where they stand, and keeps mending after. Nothing hostile takes a drop of it.
spells.name: Sacred Water

spells.description: Five bolts thrown wide in one motion. They leave your hand scattered across the arc, then bend back in and converge on whoever you were aiming at. Each one lands lighter than a clean shot, but five of them add up.
spells.name: Scattering Bullet

spells.description: Hands to the sky, and the ki you were saving for a fight goes into closing your own wounds instead. Mends a wound at once and keeps knitting for a while after.
spells.name: Second Breath

spells.description: A denser sphere of compressed ki that subtly bends toward its target. Costs more, but rarely misses.
spells.name: Seeking Bolt

spells.description: Set your skin like rock. Both defences rise and everything that lands hurts a little less, for half a minute.
spells.name: Stone Skin

spells.description: A finger raised, and the ki broken into a dozen small suns. They arc out wide and come down over everything you pointed at. Nowhere near the storm the technique it was copied from puts out, which is the point.
spells.name: Sunburst Volley

spells.description: Wind up and throw the punch anyway, from wherever you are standing. The blow leaves the fist and keeps going, and whatever it reaches gets moved. It runs out of road well short of a ki blast, so the trick is being close enough to mean it.
spells.name: Super Charging Fist

spells.description: The Dragon of Dreams' blessing turned inward. Namekian ki spent on standing your ground: far harder to put down, and slower to put anything else down.
spells.name: Super Namek (Porunga Form)

spells.description: The Eternal Dragon's power worn outright. Namekian ki turned outward: everything you throw lands harder, at the cost of the guard the other form keeps.
spells.name: Super Namek (Shenron Form)

spells.description: Ignite the legendary transformation. Golden ki erupts around you, raising every combat stat.
spells.name: Super Saiyan

spells.description: A simple white aura ignites around you. All stats rise modestly for a short window.
spells.name: Surge

spells.description: A short, brutal sweep of the arm with the current still on it. Everything standing in the arc in front of you catches it at once, and whatever it does to bone it also leaves behind a charge that will not sit still.
spells.name: Thunder Break

spells.description: Go six seconds without being touched and it shows. Faster on your feet and sharper with ki, right up until something lands.
spells.name: Untouchable

spells.description: Saiyan recovery, running while the wound is fresh. Drop below a third of your health and your attack climbs hard until you are out of danger.
spells.name: Zenkai Boost

stats.name: Max HP
stats.text: Your life pool. At zero you are down.

stats.name: Max Stamina
stats.text: Burns while sprinting, refills when you stop.

stats.name: Spirit Attack
stats.text: Raises the damage of spirit techniques.

stats.name: Spirit Defense
stats.text: Reduces the damage spirit attacks do to you.

stats.name: Strength
stats.text: Raises the damage of physical techniques.

stats.name: Endurance
stats.text: Reduces the damage physical attacks do to you.
